people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
translations.bsb: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor— the appointed time has come.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
translations.asv: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
